docTitle: Bibilo sha Mapu · Bibilo ken Mpase Môm
metaDesc: Dondo mtôôv u Icighanruamabera u Tse, uma u Yesu, man azende a Paulu sha mapu u mimi — Bibilo er ken ajiir a mimi.

s.title: Bibilo sha Mapu
s.verse: “Gadia zum u se va pase ne agee man m-ande u Ter wase Yesu Kristu la yô, kera lu sha gbenda u ukwaghhir mba i dugh a dugh sha kwaghfan la se lu zan ga, kpa se lu mba se nenge a nenge iengem Na sha ashe je.” (2 Peteru 1:16)
s.purpose: Bibilo ka mtsegh ga. Ka mnger u ior mba ve zende sha ajiir a mimi, sha ayange a mimi, man sha ati a mimi la. Dondo igbenda ne sha mapu, sha gbenda u ashighe — bende sha ijiir, shin te ▶ sha u zenden ken mi sha kar môm môm.
s.ot_kick: ① Icighanruamabera u Tse — sha ashighe
s.ot_h: Hii sha mgbe zan zan mhide hen Yerusalem
s.ot_lead: Ka igbenda i môm ga kpa ka mzende u kwaghôron u myiman hii sha mgbe zan zan: mgbe man mgbough → mngerem ma vesen man Babel → myilan (Aberaham) → tar u ityendezwa → Mdugh → deserete → mhembe → tartor → mpav → ime → mhide.
s.je_kick: ② Icighanruamabera u He — uma u Yesu
s.je_h: Hii sha Betelehem zan zan Yerusalem
s.je_lead: Dondo uma u Yesu er Avangeli a ôr la, sha gbenda — hii sha mar Na ken Betelehem, mbatisema Na man tom Na ken Galilaia, karen ken Samaria, zan zan terankon, mnder, man mkohom sha Sha ken Yerusalem.
s.pa_kick: ③ Icighanruamabera u He — azende a Paulu
s.pa_h: Hii sha Antiokia zan zan ikighir i tar — Roma
s.pa_lead: Hii sha Pentekosti ken Yerusalem, gbenda u Loho u Dedoo samber karen Yudia — karen Asia Minor man Yuropa zan zan ken atô u tartor. Tsua zende môm ken azende ataan (u hii · u sha uhar · u sha utar + mzende u za Roma + u sha mbugh) man dondo akaa a Aerenakaa A Mbaapostoli vea uwasike mba i nger sha gbenda la.
s.foot: Ape i due la · Ajiir a dondo kwaghôron u Bibilo man mfe u ajiir a Bibilo (kua ati a ainge ape a wase la). I gbe kwavaôndo, ifi, man azegemngerem sha mfe u ajiir a bugh (Natural Earth), i hôôn u i.
s.contact: Mbampin · mbamhen — Nger se imeil

eden.name: Edhen (Mgbe · Mgbough)
eden.note: Ken tar u i gbe u u lu dedoo kpishi la, isholibo nyôr shi i paa mzough u atô u Aôndo man uumace.
events: Mgbe ken ayange ataratar — “lu u doon tsung”
I gbe uumace sha ikyav i Aôndo
Mgbough, man mdugh ken Edhen
Ityendezwa i Loho u Dedoo i hii — “vor wou … u ua cagh u ityough”

noah.name: Ararat (Mngerem ma Vesen)
noah.today: Uwo u Ararat, ken ityôhô i Turkiya nyian
noah.note: Aôndo ôr tar u u iv a isholibo la ijir, kpa A kura uma sha ikyev i tsombor môm.
events: Tar u u iv a aeren a bo
Mngerem ma vesen, man tso u Noa
Ityendezwa i atsande — “á kera tim uuma sha won cii sha mngerem ma deemee ga”

babel.name: Iyou i Babel
babel.note: Sha ityendeja i i soo u kuma Sha la, Aôndo samber zwa ve man akuraior sha won cii.
events: “Sé maa nen Zegegar man gôgôyou … iti yase i̱ za gwa sha won”
Aôndo gema zwa ve
Akuraior samber sha won cii (Shinar — u hidi hingir Babilon)

ur.name: Ur
ur.note: Kwaghôron u myiman u Bibilo hii sha myilan u or môm.
events: Aôndo yila Abram ken Ur u Mbakaldia
“Me er u, ú hingir ikurior i vesen … akuraior a sha won cii aa zua a iveren”
Sha jighjigh u nan nan undu tar u ityar na

haran.name: Haran
haran.note: Sha gbenda, nan lumun myilan u za sha tar u ityendezwa.
events: Tsombor u Tera tem ken Haran
Tera kpe
Abram mough za sha Kanaan sha anyom 75

shechem.name: Shekem · Kanaan
shechem.note: Ken tar u ityendezwa i ver tsombor shi ityendezwa za hemen sha akuraior.
events: Mnyôr ken Kanaan, atari a hii — “Me na tsombor wou tar ne”
Ityendezwa (Gen 15) · Isaka · Yakob
Ônov mba Yakob mba pue kar uhar — ikyor i ikpinaior pue kar uhar

egypt.name: Igipiti (Gosen)
egypt.note: Tsombor hingir ikurior i vesen — tsô hingir ikurior i ikpan.
events: I te Yosef, kpa nan mough hingir hemen u Igipiti
Tsombor u Yakob cii va sha u yevese ijen
I gema ikurior i Iserael i i lu seer la hingir ikpan

sinai.name: Uwo u Sinai
sinai.note: Myiman u hemban ken Icighanruamabera u Tse — ikpan hingir ior mba Aôndo.
events: Uange pue man waniyôngo u Paseka
Zegemngerem u Nyian paa shi ve per
Atindi Pue, Tindi, tempel u shate man unagh

kadesh.name: Kadesh (deserete)
kadesh.note: Mnenge u jighjigh ga na ikurior môm i saa a tar la — kpa Aôndo lu vea ve.
events: Mbatimen pue kar uhar — kpa ior venda u suur
Anyom 38 ken deserete — mana, ikyô man usu
Sha tar u Moab, kwaghôron u masetyô u Mose (Duteronomi)

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: Masetyô ve nyôr ve tôô tar u ityendezwa.
events: Yordan paa shi ior per
Azende a Yeriko gbough
Mhembe u Kanaan man mpav u tar

shiloh.name: Shilo (Mbaajiriv)
shiloh.note: Er tor lu ga yô, hanmô gbaa eren kwagh sha ishima i nan tsô — i soo tor u mimi.
events: I ver tempel u shate ken Shilo
Gbenda u isholibo–mtev–myiman (Debora, Gideon, Samson)
Rutu — mimi ken ayange a ime, ken ikurior i Davidi

jerusalem.name: Yerusalem · Tartor u i Zer la
jerusalem.note: Shighe u dedoo u Iserael — man ityendezwa i tor u gbem sha won.
events: Saul tor u hii, tsô Davidi man Goliat
Ityendezwa i Davidi — “ikônough you ki torough kia lu her gbem sha won” (2 Sam 7)
Solomon maa tempel ken Yerusalem

samaria.name: Samaria · Tartor u i Paa la
samaria.note: Tartor paa shi za shin inya er mbaprofeti gbidye mliam yô.
events: Sha ayange a Solomon kar, mpav ken Yuda man Iserael
Mciviraeev u a kera ende ga
Eliya, Yesaia, Yeremia gbidye ér ‘hide nen va’ — shi ve pase Mesia

nineveh.name: Nineve (Ashiria)
nineveh.note: I venda mwanger cii, imbusu gbough hiihii.
events: Nineve, ngerenya u Ashiria
Tartor u imbusu gbough sha ikyev i Ashiria (722 cii Kristu)
I tindi Yona za sha Nineve

babylon.name: Babilon
babylon.note: Tugh ku u ime hemban — kpa ityendezwa i msoron ngu her.
events: Yerusalem gbough, i nyie tempel (586 cii Kristu)
I tee Yuda za ken Babilon
Daniel man Esekiel — jighjigh man mpase ken ime

susa.name: Susa (Persia)
susa.note: Kua ken atô u tartor u mbakera fa Aôndo ga kpaa, Aôndo kura ior Nav.
events: Persia hemba Babilon
Eseter yima Mbayuda sha mtim
Nehemia er msen sha ishigh ki tor shi i tindi un

return.name: Mhide hen Yerusalem
return.note: Ve hide ve maa shi — kpa tor va ga. Ve kegh Mesia.
events: Mhide sha akôr ataratar sha mtindi u Sairus (Serubabel 538 · Esera 458 · Nehemia 444)
I maa tempel shi i sôr azende a Yerusalem
Malaki — Icighanruamabera u Tse kure: “M ngu tindin ortyom Wam”

bethlehem.name: Betelehem
bethlehem.note: Mesia u i tôô ityendezwa la va ken gar u Davidi — Imo i hingir iyol.
events: I mar Un ken Betelehem, gar u Davidi
Mbatyomov pase mbakuranilev loho
Mbafankwagh va civir Un

nazareth.name: Nasareti
nazareth.note: Aôndo vese er or ken gar u ikyol.
events: I vese Un ken ya u orkomkon
Sha anyom pue kar uhar, pinen shi lumun mbin ken tempel
Ken masetyô i venda Un ken sinagog u ityar na

jordan.name: Ifi Yordan
jordan.note: Tom Na sha igbar hii — Sha pase Un er Wan.
events: Yohane er Un batisema
Jijingi hô er kwaghegh nahan — “ka Wan Wam u ishima ishima, u i doom a na yum”
A hemba imeen i Satan itaar ken deserete

cana.name: Kana
cana.note: Ken ikyav i hii Na A tese icivir Na.
events: Vannya sha kwaghkuhwan
Mngerem hingir wain — ikyav i hii Na
Mbahenen Nav na un jighjigh

sychar.name: Sikar (Samaria)
sychar.note: Gbenda u tom u hiihii — karen Yerusalem zan zan Samaria u i laha la.
events: A wanger tempel ken Yerusalem
Sha tugh, Nikodemu — “u á mar ne hegh keng”
Mngerem ma uma sha kwase u Samaria

capernaum.name: Kapernaum
capernaum.today: hen kwavaôndo u zegemngerem u Galilaia nyian
capernaum.note: Ijiir i tom u Galilaia — myilan, mtesen man mhendan cii zua heen.
events: A yila mbakôrunov shi A ver ijiir heen
Kwaghôron u sha Uwo — “Saan mba ve lu mbaibanave ken jijingi la iyol”
Anzaakaa a tartor — man mhendan u u seer la

galilee.name: Zegemngerem u Galilaia
galilee.note: Sha agee sha akaa a Aôndo gba la A tese Un er ka an ye.
events: “Huan, lu ving” — A kunde ahumbe
A koson ior 5,000 sha ubredi utaan man ishu ihar
A zende sha mngerem

caesarea_p.name: Kaisaria Filipi
caesarea_p.note: Mbahenen kav ér Un ka Kristu, shi gbenda u terankon bugh.
events: Mpase u Peteru — “We U ngu Kristu Wan u Aôndo u uma”
A vande pasen ku Na man mnder Na
I gema Un ken icivir sha uwo

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: Sha gbenda u za sha Yerusalem, A keren mba ve saa la.
events: A bugh ashe a Bartimeu orpirir
A yila Sakeu orkohol u imkombo
“Wan u or va sha u keren man u yiman kwagh u a saa”

bethany.name: Betania
bethany.note: A tese agee sha ku sha ikyua i sati u masetyô Na.
events: A nder Lasaru ken uar — “Mo M ngu mnder man uma”
Maria shime Un mkurem sha ci u mtemen
Ikyav ne taver mhen u wuan Un

jerusalem.name: Yerusalem
jerusalem.note: Ijiir i vesen i Bibilo cii i tese la — terankon, mnder, man mkohom sha Sha.
events: Mnyôr sha icivir; A gbidye utebur mba ken tempel shi
Sha Kwaghyan u Masetyô A ôô mbahenen Nav angahar
A kpe sha terankon
A nder sha iyange i sha itaar, tsô A kohom sha Sha

antioch.name: Antiokia
antioch.note: Nyianegh ki mtindi ki tom u mbagenev u hii shi u hide van la.
events: Sha msen Jijingi paav Barnaba man Saul
Nyianegh ki i vande yilan mbananjighjigh ér ‘Mbakristu’ heen la
Ijiir i mhii u azende a hii, a sha uhar man a sha utar

seleucia.name: Seleukia
seleucia.note: Ijiir i tso i Antiokia — ve mough sha tso ve za Kipro.

salamis.name: Salami (Kipro)
salamis.note: Ijiir i hii ken Kipro — mpase kwagh ken usinagog.

paphos.name: Pafo
paphos.note: I tese agee sha mba ve hendan a Loho u Dedoo la.
events: Elima ortseren hingir orpirir
Sergiu Paulu gomna na jighjigh
Hii heen ‘Paulu’ tôô hemen

perga.name: Perga
perga.note: Ijiir i tso ken Pamfilia — heen Yohane Marku hide.

pantioch.name: Antiokia u Pisidia
pantioch.note: Loho u Dedoo bugh gbenda za sha mbagenev.
events: Kwaghôron u gbee u kwaghôron u myiman ken sinagog
Mbagenev kpishi eren iember shi ngohol kwagh
I dugh ve sha mhendan

iconium.name: Ikonia
iconium.note: Kpishi na jighjigh, kpa mtev na ve yem hemen.

lystra.name: Listra
lystra.note: I civir ve er aôndo, tsô i ta ve iwen.
events: A bee or u lu angôsôô hii mar na
Zegeior nôngo u naan ve nagh er aôndo
I ta un iwen i undu un er nan kpe, kpa nan mough

derbe.name: Derbe
derbe.note: I gber mbahenen kpishi; ve hide sha gbenda ve sha u taver mbananyianegh asema.

troas.name: Troa
troas.note: Ijiir i mgem ape Loho u Dedoo za sha Yuropa sha hiihii la.
events: Mpase u or u Makedonia
“per yande Masedonia keen, va wase se”
Ve per za sha Yuropa fefa

philippi.name: Filipi
philippi.note: Nyianegh ki hii ki Yuropa — Loho u Dedoo hemba kua ken gaadi kpaa.
events: Lidia, orkasua u ikyondo i nyian la, na jighjigh
I pase wankye u ikpan u eren mtseren la
Atsam sha tugh, mnyaghayol u tar, tsombor u orkuran gaadi zua a myiman

thess.name: Tesalonika
thess.note: Kwagh u nyaghyô gar shi mhendan mough taveraa.
events: A lam ken sinagog Ayange a Memen ataratar
“Ior mba ve vihi tar cii ne”
Ve due sha tugh

berea.name: Beroia
berea.note: Mba dedoo mba ve time kwagh sha ayol a ve la.
events: Ve ngohol kwagh a ishima i môm
Hanma iyange ve time icighanruamabera sha u kaven mi
Kpishi va na jighjigh

athens.name: Ateni
athens.note: Ken gar u mbafankwagh A pase ‘aôndo u i fe un ga la’.
events: Gar u u iv a aeev vihi un ishima
Sha Areopagu A pase Orgba man mnder
I pfeghe un, kpa mbagenev na jighjigh

corinth.name: Korinti
corinth.note: A tema anyom môm man atô, A gbe nyianegh ken gar u aeren a bo.
events: A gber utenti vea Akwila man Priskila
“De cie ga … gadia Mo M ngu a we”
Mbakorinti kpishi na jighjigh shi i er ve batisema

ephesus.name: Efesu
ephesus.note: Atô u zende u sha utar — kwagh samber ken Asia cii.
events: Mtesen hanma iyange anyom ihar ken iyou i Tiranu
I nyie utakerada mba tseren; aeren a agee
Demetriu ortsurugh na iyua mough

miletus.name: Mileto
miletus.note: Mpav u mliam a mbatamen mba Efesu.
events: “Kuran nen … koso nongo u Kristu u Aôndo, u A yem sha awambe a sha iyol Na la”
Mbatamen vaan mliam, ve fa ér vea kera nenge a Na ga

caesarea.name: Kaisaria
caesarea.note: Anyom ihar A war Loho u Dedoo sha ishigh ki gomnaov man tor.
events: Ijir sha ishigh ki gomnaov Feliki man Festu
Mwar u iyol na sha ishigh ki tor Agripa
“Me za a ijir ne hen Shisar” — za sha Roma

jerusalem.name: Yerusalem
jerusalem.note: I kôr un ken tempel, gbenda na er orgba yô hii.
events: Zegeior kôr un ken tempel
A war iyol na sha ishigh ki mbatamen
Er ortar u Roma nahan, i tindi un a mbakuran za sha Kaisaria

myra.name: Mira
myra.note: Ve gema tso u Aleksandria u u za Roma la.

fairhaven.name: Fair Havens (Kreti)
fairhaven.note: I ungwa mwanger u Paulu u kaan ér i de mzende sha tso la ga.

crete.name: Kreti
crete.note: Sha mbugh na, icighanya i u undu Titu heen sha u wanger mbananyianegh la.
events: A undu Titu sha u veren mbatamen ken hanma gar
A kaa ér i ver mbahemen mba i taver ve ibo ga, mba mimi
A nger uwasike hen Titu

malta.name: Malta
malta.note: Karen ahumbe man mgbough u tso, ityendezwa i Aôndo tile dông.
events: Ahumbe gbough tso, kpa ior 276 cii war
Iyô kôr un kpa nan zua a mtoghom ga
A bee mbauange mba ken icighanya la

syracuse.name: Sirakusa
syracuse.note: Ve tema ayange ataratar ken Sicily.

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.note: Ve nyôr Italia shi mbananjighjigh mba imôngo zua a ve.

rome.name: Roma
rome.book: Aerenakaa A Mbaapostoli 28 · Uwasike mba ken Gaadi · 2 Timoteu
rome.note: Loho u Dedoo ar ken atô u tartor masetyô — ka mkure ga kpa ka mhii.
events: Anyom ihar ken mkôr u ya, A pase tartor sha agee
Hii heen A nger Uwasike mba ken Gaadi (Efe·Fil·Kol·Flm)
Ken masetyô i kôr un ken gaadi shi, A nger 2 Timoteu shi i wua un sha ci u jighjigh — “M nôngo ityav mbi dedoo ve. M kure ayem am vough”

journeys.rome: Zende u sha unyiin · za Roma
journeys.j5: Zende u sha utaan · sha mbugh
